main.label: The drained Borg power-dived anyway
main.explanation: A drained Borg (experience below its maximum) at depth 15 is otherwise fully prepared: borg_prepared(15) and borg_prepared(20) are NULL, nothing has chosen a direction, and the power-dive check borg_prepared(CDEPTH + 5) is satisfied. The "do not dive when drained" guard read if (g && BI_ISFIXEXP), but g is only non-zero there when an earlier branch already decided to head up - so for a Borg that had not yet chosen a direction the guard was dead and the drained Borg took the dive. The correction applies the guard unconditionally, matching the sibling "full of items" check and the original dive-cancellation shape.
